title: ping_l2: debug and fix lichen_link_tx -ENOENT ('TX frame build failed: unknown error (-2)') at lichen_l2_tx.c:154
description: Child 1 of 5fva (debug order per bead: this first). lichen_l2_tx -> lichen_link_tx returns -ENOENT; lichen_link_tx.c's own returns are EINVAL/ENOKEY/EPROTONOSUPPORT/EBUSY/ENOMEM/EMSGSIZE, so -ENOENT propagates from a callee (candidates: lichen_replay_settings_reserve_tx_epoch / epoch-persist paths in next_tx, or deeper in sign/CCA; ENOENT sources live in epoch_persist.c:117, replay_persist.c:234, oscore persistence/settings). Also fix lichen_link_strerror printing 'unknown error (-2)' for ENOENT (missing table entry - secondary diagnosability bug). Build ping_l2 native_sim on heft (source ~/Developer/lichen-env.sh), capture the runtime trace, fix the drift (likely test-side key/epoch provisioning missing after a refactor), land with the test passing. Note: ping_l2 needs prj.conf unblocks (MESSAGE_SIZE=1024, COAP_CLIENT_THREAD_PRIORITY=14) - already in place per parent bead.
close_reason: Fixed and validated 7/7 (1j89). The bead's original -ENOENT symptom evolved across three proven root causes, each landed and reviewed: (1) missing post-reinit key re-provision (84908feee9), (2) frame_len=0 passed as TX capacity (237dc35064), (3) stale legacy link-key load arming the E=1 rejection + non-canonical peer registration (24cde81e5a), plus the loopback one-shot arming fix (cf9afa78a1) and the monotonic nonce stream (75b86d62cd). test_full_l2_loopback_ping PASSES.
